Let me look at the logs more carefully — the build might be failing, or it could be that some modules' dependencies haven't been built yet (which is normal with a multi-module build using `-Dmaven.artifact.threads`… actually no, in a clean build the reactor should handle that).

Let me check the logs in more detail.
